product.heroDescription: Open comic book archives on your Roku TV with a clean, remote-friendly interface. Connect from your phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network, choose one or more comics, and read them on the big screen with zoom, fit modes, rotation, night mode, page thumbnails, Go to Page, and resume support.

features.title: Features Built for Big-Screen Comic Reading

cards.title: Made for Roku TV
bullets: Designed for Roku TV and remote control navigation
Large labels, clear focus states, and simple D-pad movement
Move between Connect, Library, Settings, Help, and the full-screen reader
TV-optimized screens for comfortable reading from the couch

cards.title: Easy Local Pairing
bullets: Connect from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network
Scan the QR code shown on your Roku screen
Use the short manual address if you prefer typing the link
Connection status and retry options help you reconnect when needed

cards.title: Comic Archive Selection
bullets: Choose one comic, multiple comics, or a folder where supported
Drag and drop comic archives in supported browsers
Duplicate selections are skipped so your library stays clean
Selected comics show format, file size, page count, and remove actions

cards.title: Supported Comic Formats
bullets: Supports CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, CB7, 7Z, CBT, and TAR archives
Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, and JPEG 2000 page images
Uses natural page ordering so page 2 appears before page 10
Supports localized and Unicode comic file names

cards.title: Remote-Friendly Library
bullets: Browse selected comics in a Roku-friendly grid
Comic cards show first-page thumbnails and clean file names
Open the focused comic with the OK button
Empty library guidance sends you back to the Connect screen

cards.title: Full-Screen Comic Reader
bullets: Read selected comics in a full-screen TV viewer
Use Left and Right to move between pages
Use Back to return to the Library without losing the active session
The reader keeps your last visible page on screen during brief loading moments

cards.title: Reading Controls
bullets: Zoom in and out for panel-level reading
Switch fit modes for different page shapes
Rotate pages in 90-degree steps
Toggle night mode for easier dark-room reading

cards.title: Pan and Page Movement
bullets: Pan vertically or horizontally when a zoomed page is larger than the screen
Long-press D-pad controls for smooth repeated panning
Pan boundaries keep the page from moving off screen
Left and Right return to page navigation when horizontal panning is not needed

cards.title: Page Thumbnails
bullets: Open a full-screen page thumbnail navigator
Browse nearby pages with a focused center thumbnail
Select a thumbnail to jump directly to that page
Cancel thumbnail navigation without changing pages

cards.title: Go to Page
bullets: Open a TV-friendly numeric keypad
Enter a page number with the D-pad and OK button
Delete digits before submitting
Jump only to valid pages within the current comic

cards.title: Resume Reading
bullets: Reopen a comic at the last page you were reading
Restore saved zoom, fit mode, rotation, pan, and night mode
Open new comics with sensible default viewing settings
Return from the reader to the Library without clearing your selected comics

cards.title: Subscription Support
bullets: Subscribe or manage your subscription from the app menu
Subscription purchase and recovery flows use the Roku channel store
Free users may be limited to the first configured number of pages per comic
Subscribed users can continue reading later pages without the page limit prompt

cards.title: Settings and Storage Tools
bullets: View TV screen resolution and screen ratio
Check temporary viewing file count and storage usage
Clear temporary storage when needed
See clear success, no-data, and failure messages for cleanup actions

cards.title: Help, Legal, and Support
bullets: Built-in Help/FAQ page with expandable questions
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages
About page with app, developer, and version details
Support and feedback page with QR codes for useful links

cards.title: Local Viewing Design
bullets: Comic archives are selected from your own phone, tablet, or computer
No external upload service is required for comic content
Roku does not persist original comic archive files
Temporary viewing data can be cleared from Settings

cards.title: Localization Ready
bullets: Roku interface text uses localized app strings
Reader controls, page prompts, settings, and subscription messages support translation
The companion selection page includes localized status and error messages
Browser language selection can be stored locally

items.text: Read CBZ, CBR, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, and other supported comic archives from your own collection on a Roku TV.

items.title: Couch Reading
items.text: Enjoy comics on a larger screen with simple remote navigation, zoom, pan, rotation, and night mode.

items.title: Local Wi-Fi Viewing
items.text: Choose comics from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network without needing an external upload service.

items.q: What is TV Comic Book Reader?
items.a: TV Comic Book Reader is a Roku app for reading comic book archives on your TV with a remote-friendly interface.

items.q: How do I open comics on my Roku TV?
items.a: Open the Connect screen, scan the QR code or enter the short address from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network, then choose the comic archives you want to read.

items.q: Which comic archive formats are supported?
items.a: The app supports CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, CB7, 7Z, CBT, and TAR archives containing readable image pages.

items.q: Which page image formats are supported?
items.a: Supported page image formats include JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, and JPEG 2000 variants.

items.q: Can I choose more than one comic?
items.a: Yes. You can select multiple comic archives, and folder selection may also be available on supported devices and browsers.

items.q: Do my device and Roku need to be on the same Wi-Fi network?
items.a: Yes. The phone, tablet, or computer used to choose comics should be connected to the same local Wi-Fi network as your Roku device.

items.q: Does the app remember where I stopped?
items.a: Yes. The reader can reopen a comic with the last page and viewing settings such as zoom, fit mode, rotation, pan, and night mode.

items.q: Can I zoom, pan, rotate, or change the reading view?
items.a: Yes. The options overlay includes zoom, fit mode, rotate, night mode, thumbnails, Go to Page, and close controls. When a page is zoomed, you can pan with the D-pad.

items.q: Does Roku store my original comic archive files?
items.a: No. TV Comic Book Reader is designed for local viewing and does not persist original comic archive files on Roku. Temporary viewing data can be cleared from Settings.

items.q: Where can I manage subscription information?
items.a: The app includes Subscribe and Manage Subscription options. Subscription purchase and recovery use the Roku channel store flow.
